title: The Orchard That Paid in Wax
story: In the Wax Orchard, every pear is dipped in honey-wax and sold for glimmer-chits. Tallowmourn, a tall drippy keeper made of melted candles, refuses to release the trapped pickers until someone proves he has been shorting them. Mr 6 pulls out a wax tablet and starts scratching numbers with the tip of his sword.
question: The pickers gathered 480 wax pears. Tallowmourn takes 35% of the pears as his "orchard tithe," then the pickers sell the rest for 3 glimmer-chits each. How many glimmer-chits do the pickers earn?
praise: Finding 35% was exactly the right opening move — the pickers keep the OTHER part, and then it gets multiplied by the price.
hint: First find how many pears Tallowmourn takes, then ask: how many are left to sell?
victory: Tallowmourn melts into a sheepish puddle, admits his tithe was sticky arithmetic, and hands back every chit. The pickers light him as a lamp — he says it's the warmest job he's ever had.
imagePrompt: A tall drippy candle-man keeper slumping among glowing wax pear trees at dusk while a small knightly numeral 6 holds up a tally tablet, golden candlelight and amber mood.
